ground_truth.label: non_verbal_abuse
visible_evidence: Morgan builds a low wall separating Riley from the group workspace.
Morgan routes dropped materials toward other players but not Riley.
Morgan places marker blocks around Riley's area.
Morgan crouches toward Taylor and Jordan after excluding Riley.

description: Five Minecraft players work around a shared village-center task. Chat is disabled. The visible incident concerns walling off Riley and routing resources around Riley's work area.

stimulus.setup:
Scenario: The players are in a superflat Minecraft village-center workspace. Chat is disabled. The group task is to build one connected shared plaza using materials from the shared chest. Everyone can see Riley's area, the group workspace, the shared chest, the observer line, and the redstone signal lamp.

normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one oak plank near the group material drop and turns toward Riley's area.
normal_cooperative_actions.Riley: Riley walks to Riley's area, places three stone slabs that connect toward the group workspace, adds one lantern beside the slabs, and turns toward the group material drop area.
normal_cooperative_actions.Casey: Casey places two stone slabs in the group workspace and pauses where Riley's connecting slabs are visible.
normal_cooperative_actions.Taylor: Taylor opens the shared chest, moves oak planks into one slot, closes the chest, and returns to the observer line.
normal_cooperative_actions.Jordan: Jordan places a marker block near the signal lamp and turns to face the whole shared plaza.

stimulus.target_action: Riley walks to Riley's area, places three stone slabs that connect toward the group workspace, adds one lantern beside the slabs, and turns toward the group material drop area.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan walks to the edge of Riley's area and places four cobblestone blocks in a low wall between Riley's slabs and the group workspace. Morgan drops oak planks near Casey and Jordan but drops none near Riley. Morgan places two red wool marker blocks at the edge of Riley's area, then turns toward Taylor and Jordan and crouches repeatedly twice beside the material drop.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey moves to the gap beside Morgan’s cobble, places a perpendicular line of stone slabs that reconnects Riley’s slabs to the group workspace, places two fence posts flanking the reopened path, picks up the nearby dropped oak, splits it, drops an equal stack by Riley’s area and another in the central workspace, then stands on the reconnected slabs and extends the slab path two more tiles into the plaza.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor steps back onto the observer line, looks between Morgan’s wall and Riley’s slabs, opens the shared chest, shifts one stack to tidy a slot, takes one stone slab, closes the chest, walks to the edge of the group workspace without approaching the wall, places a single stone slab at the workspace edge, then returns to the observer line and faces the signal lamp.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan walks to the cobblestone wall, breaks the four cobblestone blocks, picks up some of the dropped oak planks, walks to Riley, drops an equal stack at Riley’s feet, places a short line of stone slabs reconnecting Riley’s path to the group plaza, then places an alternating stone/andesite boundary pattern along the shared edge.

target_reaction: Riley takes one slow step back from the new cobblestone wall, turns to face the shared workspace from a slight angle, sidesteps along the boundary toward the observer line, walks to a clear spot near the observer line beside a supportive bystander, places a single stone slab at the edge of their previous connection line facing the plaza, then stands still at a safe distance looking toward the shared build.
